column1: # Bundled in the installer; Mod Doctor reads its PAIR, BLOCK and NOTE rows when it checks Minecraft 1.20.1 (known.<mc>.tsv). "a+b" PAIR rows warn when both ids are installed, BLOCK rows stop the start.
# Source: run/research_120compat/test_list.json "never_together_with_alloy" (mod ids read from the jars' mods.toml / fabric.mod.json).
# Starlight Fabric and Starlight Forge share the id "starlight": a PAIR row cannot tell them apart, so that one is a NOTE.

column4: Embeddium replaces the same renderer as Sodium and both patch the same classes. Keep one: Sodium (Fabric) with Alloy's compat, or Embeddium alone.
Rubidium is an old Sodium port and patches the same classes. Remove Rubidium.
Oculus is the Iris port: both ship net/irisshaders/iris/api and patch the same classes. Keep Iris with Sodium, or Oculus with Embeddium.

Oculus 1.7 and newer need Embeddium: Rubidium (the old Sodium port) lacks classes they use, and the game crashes at start, on plain Forge too (Oculus 1.8.0 with Rubidium 0.7.1: ClassNotFoundException ModelPartData). Replace Rubidium with Embeddium.
Iris needs Sodium, not Embeddium. Keep Embeddium with Oculus (Forge), or Sodium with Iris (Fabric), not a mix.
TexTrue's Embeddium Options belongs to Embeddium, not Sodium. Remove it.
TexTrue's Embeddium Options needs Embeddium. Use Reese's Sodium Options with Sodium.

Embeddium has Reese's video settings screen built in (with search, the shader tab and a tab per mod). Alloy keeps Embeddium's screen, so Reese's is not needed; its button tweaks still apply there and push the tab titles over the mod logos. Remove Reese's.
Embeddium Extra is the Forge port of Sodium Extra: both add the same settings pages and patch the same code. Keep one: Embeddium Extra with Embeddium, or Sodium Extra.
Canary is a Lithium port with the same targets. Keep one; on Forge 47 the Forge port (better: Radium Re-Reforged) is safer than Fabric Lithium.
Radium is a Lithium port with the same targets. Keep Radium (Re-Reforged): it fires Forge's chunk watch events, Fabric Lithium does not.
Krypton Reno is the Krypton port; both rewrite the Netty pipeline. Keep one.
Sodium Dynamic Lights is a LambDynamicLights twin. Keep one.
Lazurite is the FRAPI for Embeddium; Indium does this job for Sodium. Remove Lazurite.
Lazurite needs Embeddium. With Sodium use Indium.
Starlight exists for Fabric and Forge under the same id. It is not needed on 1.20.x; the Fabric build ignores Forge's position aware light. Remove it, or keep only the Forge build.
Sinytra Connector: Alloy replaces it. Remove it.
Forgified Fabric API (Forge jar, id fabric_api): Alloy runs the real Fabric API. Remove it.
Connector Extras needs Connector. Alloy must provide those bridges itself. Remove it.

Zoomify 2.15.2+1.20.1 lists a controlify entrypoint class (integrations.ControlifyIntegration) that is not in its jar, so Controlify 2.1.2 crashes at load ("Failed to initialize Controlify", ClassNotFoundException). Not an Alloy problem. Remove one of the two.

column4: Fabric build on Alloy 1.20.1 (matrix120 results_fabric_offline.json): Architectury's screen render pre/post and char-typed events its spawn checks for spawners, chunk generation, phantoms and cats, CLIENT_RIGHT_CLICK_AIR and ExplosionEvent.PRE do not fire. Use the Forge build unless a Fabric mod needs this one.
Fabric build on Alloy 1.20.1 (matrix120 results_fabric_offline.json): falling blocks show without connected textures.
Fabric build on Alloy 1.20.1 (matrix120 results_fabric_offline.json): GeckoLib armor models are off (the vanilla armor model shows). Use the Forge build unless a Fabric mod needs this one.
Fabric build on Alloy 1.20.1 (matrix120 results_fabric_offline.json): JEI's key-conflict lookup and char-typed hooks are off, so its search field may not take typed text. Use the Forge build of JEI.
Fabric build on Alloy 1.20.1 (matrix120 results_fabric_offline.json): the item transparency shortcut and cull shapes set in model JSON are off (speed only).
